  requires-python = ">=3.11"

  [tool.marimo.runtime]
  cache_cells = true

```{python .marimo}
import sys
import numpy as np
from types import SimpleNamespace

if sys.platform == "emscripten":
    raise RuntimeError("A_EXECUTED_IN_BROWSER")
x = np.arange(1, 5, dtype=float)
config = SimpleNamespace(label="nested")
```

```{python .marimo}
import marimo as mo
slider = mo.ui.slider(1, 10, value=2)
mo.vstack([slider, mo.md(f"UI_RUNTIME: {__import__('sys').platform}")])
```

```{python .marimo}
f"{config.label}: {(x * slider.value).tolist()}"
```
